message.content:
This vertical, rectangular editorial illustration features a red border on the left and a red-and-white hatched background. Across the top, capitalized black text reads "KIBANG-KIBUT HOAKS CORONA" and "DI BALIK PENCABUTAN SERTIFIKASI KAYU." Below, large, semi-transparent white letters spell "TEMPO." A faint, smaller line of text lies underneath. To the left, a green and yellow filigree design is visible.

A large number "75.000.000.000.000" in red with white outlines spans the center. Below this, two figures in green-outlined protective gear, including face shields and masks, face forward. A spiked sphere is to the upper left of the left figure. Green and red text at the bottom reads: "PRESIDEN JOKO WIDODO MENAMBAH BELANJA KESEHATAN RP 75 TRILIUN UNTUK PENANGANAN WABAH COVID-19. DI LAPANGAN, PENGADAAN DAN DISTRIBUSI ALAT MEDIS CENTANG-PERENANG."

In the bottom left is a black-and-white QR code. In the bottom right are a barcode, the number "00007," and smaller, partially illegible text and numbers. All elements are layered over the hatched background.
